title: Carey Cottage Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: What better way to enjoy a house by the sea, than to stay in a place that makes you feel like you're just that, by the sea! From the inviting front porch chairs and hammock to the gorgeous wooden floors and cabinetry throughout the main level.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Steps to private Savannah Street Pavilion beach access and town center - Screened porch with hammock and sitting area - Outdoor shower - You will have a total of 8 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - HUGE 2nd level primary retreat with sitting area, TV and balcony with two rocking chairs - Fitness center, playground, tennis center and two of three accessible pools at the end of the street - 2x beach cruiser bikes - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Fully stocked kitchen and outdoor grill - Serena & Lily white and blue décor throughout + high quality bed and bath linens - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. Oversized towels in each bathroom are provided. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) As one of the original bungalows, Carey Cottage perfectly preserves the traditional Seaside vacation for family and friends that want to slow down for a weekend, a week, or more, and make memories to last a lifetime. Nestled in the heart of old town charm, and about as close to the beach as you can get, enjoy conveniently short strolls or bike rides to a private beach pavilion, and the center of Seaside with all the shops and restaurants made famous by generations of visitors. If you prefer to dine in, Carey Cottage provides a fully-equipped kitchen, outdoor grill, and comfortable screened in porch with a hammock and seating area, ideal for gathering and reminiscing after a relaxing day at the beach. Designed with cozy in mind, from a sip of coffee on the upstairs balcony, to a refreshing rinse in the outdoor shower, and much like the town itself, Carey Cottage is perfectly sized to help you and your loved ones relax, unwind, and savor the Seaside salty breeze. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 8) Main Level Guest Room: Queen Bed Bunk Room: Twin over Twin built-in Bunk Beds + Twin Daybed and Trundle Shared Hallway Bathroom with shower/tub combo Second Level Primary Retreat: King Bed, Private Bathroom and Balcony IMPORTANT DETAILS: ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. ** 2 complimentary bikes** FREE Wi-Fi

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
